clinician.trajectory_summary: A 63-year-old man with longstanding psoriasis and well-controlled HIV presented with recurrent generalized scaly erythema and multiple erythematous patches. Routine serology on admission revealed positive TPPA and a high TRUST titre (1:2048), indicating syphilis infection. A skin biopsy was performed, and histopathology confirmed psoriasiform secondary syphilis features.
